# PathActionFunctional

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A scalar functional assigning an action value to each path in a network, analogous to Lagrangian action in physics, encoding cost or energy of traversal. Serves as the core optimization target for topology evolution, enabling energy-aware routing and resource allocation in TCC systems.
